milestones: Make what exists trustworthy: fidelity, tests, signed builds, updates.
PowerPoint-level WYSIWYG slides: free placement, full formatting, PPTX parity. Plan: docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md
Deeper visual editing for slides, boards and sheets.
Structured MCP tools and per-change review of AI edits.
issues: Markdown fidelity corpus for the page editor

Collect 50+ real-world Markdown files (GFM, footnotes, HTML, front matter, Obsidian syntax). For each: open in the Write view, make one edit, assert that only the edited lines change. Run in CI. Fix every lossy construct found.
Use electron-updater with the GitHub provider. Check on start and once a day, download in the background, offer "Restart to update". Respect a setting to turn it off.
Sign and notarize the macOS build
Add Developer ID certificate and notarization secrets to the Release workflow (already wired, see release.yml). Verify Gatekeeper opens the app without a warning.
Choose a code-signing route (Azure Trusted Signing or an OV certificate), add it to electron-builder, verify SmartScreen reputation.
Render footnotes and maths in the page editor
Footnotes and KaTeX maths are shown as source in the Write view. Draw them like callouts (decorations or node views) without changing the Markdown.
Accessibility audit of the canvas and the grid
Keyboard-only creation and connection of shapes, screen-reader names for shapes and cells, focus order in the inspector. WCAG 2.2 AA.
Render only visible rows and columns so a 10,000 row sheet scrolls at 60 fps; recalculate only dependants of an edited cell.
Edit slides directly on the stage
Click a text block on the slide to edit it in place; drag images to swap sides; the Markdown updates. Keep the per-slide Markdown editor.
Incremental lists and transitions in slides
Support Marp fragmented lists (`*` bullets) in the presenter, and the `transition` directive, and export them to PowerPoint animations.
Presenter view with notes on a second screen
When two displays are connected, show the slide full screen on one and notes, timer and next slide on the other.
Draggable waypoints on connectors, reconnect endpoints by dragging, store waypoints in board-md (`{via: 120,40 200,40}`).
Messages between lifelines ordered top to bottom, activation bars, return messages; written as `a ->> b "call"` in board-md.
Images and freehand drawing on boards
Drop images on the canvas (saved to assets/), and a pen tool whose strokes are stored as compact paths.
Support `=Rates!B2` and `=SUM(Costs!D2:D5)`, plus named ranges stored in the sheet comment.
Field types, validation and conditional formatting
Airtable-style column types (single select, checkbox, date, link), dropdown validation, and rules such as "value > 1000 is bold".
Open .xlsx and .csv as a new sheet-md file, keeping formulas, number formats and several sheets.
More chart types and axis titles
Donut, combo (bars and line), axis titles, value labels; same in PowerPoint export.
Accept or reject AI edits change by change
Turn the Review sheet into a per-hunk review: accept, reject or edit each change an assistant made, like a tracked-changes view.
Structured MCP tools for slides, boards and sheets
Add tools such as add_slide, set_layout, add_shape, connect, set_cell and add_chart so assistants edit without rewriting whole files.
Ask your AI from inside Folio
A command palette entry that sends the selection to the user's connected assistant and shows the answer as a reviewable edit.
Optional git-backed history per folder: timeline, diff, restore.
[S0] Slides model: placed boxes, shapes and image geometry
Parse/serialise ::: box, ::: shape and image {x y w h}. Lossless round-trip tests; untouched decks byte-identical. Update FORMATS.md. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S1] Slides canvas: select, drag, resize, rotate, snap
Moveable + Selecto. Marquee, modifiers, arrow nudge, smart guides. One minimal text edit per transform; undo/redo. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S2] Slides arrange: align, distribute, z-order, group, lock
Arrange menu parity with PowerPoint; duplicate, copy/paste across slides; place a flow block. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S3] Slides text: inline rich editing inside boxes
TipTap per box: font, size, colour, alignment, spacing, lists, autofit, vertical align. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S4] Slides insert: shapes, connectors, images, tables, charts, media, maths
Insert ribbon parity with Google Slides; image crop/replace/mask; connectors follow shapes. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S5] Slides format pane, themes, masters, editable layouts
Fill, gradient, border, shadow, opacity, radius; theme/master editing; backgrounds; slide size. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S6] Slides sorter, sections, transitions and animations
Sorter grid, hide/skip, build order timeline; export animations to PPTX where supported. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
Timer, next slide, notes, laser, pen, black/white screen, rehearsal. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
Reference deck survives import then export visually unchanged; Google Slides via PPTX. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
add_slide_element, move_element, restyle_slide; agent builds a positioned deck end to end. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
[S10] Slides polish: a11y, performance, visual regression
Keyboard-only editing, 200-slide decks, 60 fps drag, devShot visual diffs in CI. See docs/SLIDES-PLAN.md.
